resources.string: You have a letter 💌
Open the letter
A letter from the developer
Hi, I'm the developer\nof 1 Day 1 Diary 👋

I know the app has caused you some frustration, so I rebuilt it **from scratch**. **Your photos are now backed up too**, and there are new features you'll find useful.\n\nTo keep the updates coming, I've added ads and paid features. In return, I'm making you two promises.
From SeoJuNyang
Continue
Your photos are backed up too
With automatic backup on, entries go to your Google Drive once a day.\nChange phones and your diary and photos are still there.
One line a day is enough
Pick a mood and jot down a few lines.
Your diary, only in your Drive
No sign-up. Back up to your own Google Drive,\nphotos included.
Next
Get started

resources.string: Features you've been using stay free
No ads while you write or read an entry
I hope you'll stay with me 🙇‍♂️
Style your words
Try bold, text color, highlight, and lists.\nDrafts save automatically as you write.
Deleted by mistake? No problem
You can restore entries from Trash for 30 days.
To everyone who uses 1 Day 1 Diary
If there is a feature you would like, let us know.
Send feedback
Easier to find and look back
Find entries by mood, weather, or date range,\nand see your moods by week, month, or year.
More room on a tablet
See your list and an entry side by side,\nand write right away with a keyboard.
Look back on past days
See how your moods flow at a glance,\nand find entries by mood, weather, or date range.
